then.text: Hope Hilda's happy. Tell her the cows send their love.
Hilda's run out? On a Saturday? Here, take a pot. Made this morning.
You take good creamy milk, heat it gently in a shallow pan for hours, then leave it to cool overnight. The cream rises and clots into that golden crust. No shortcuts.

else.text: {greeting} Clotted cream, made here the old way. Devon cows, Devon grass, Devon rain. Mostly Devon rain.
The South Devon is our breed, the biggest of the native British cattle. Gentle as you like. Golden-red coats. Milk like silk.

dairy_cow.text: It looks at you with enormous, patient eyes, then goes back to thinking about grass.
